successors.name: Avar Khaganate
successors.text: 'They lived on the lower Danube River, in the northwestern Black Sea region (present-day Moldova and central Ukraine)'; Jordanes: 'along the curve of the Black Sea' from the Dniester to the Dnieper

ledger.x: 518: the Antes first appear in the Roman record.
About 562: the Avars and the Antes fight.
602: the Antes' land passes to the Avars.

wars.name: Antes invasion of the Diocese of Thrace
wars.outcome: 'Sometime between 533 and 545, the Antes invaded the Diocese of Thrace, enslaving many Romans'; in 545 they 'became Roman allies (after approaching the Romans) and were given gold payments' and a fort named Turris, location uncertain.

wars.name: Avar-Antes wars
wars.outcome: The Avars 'conquered and incorporated various nomadic tribes ... and defeated the Antes' (562); in 602 Apsich is sent to 'destroy the nation of the Antes'; the Antes vanish from the sources.

certainty.note: Tribal union known from Procopius, Jordanes and Menander; no page gives a boundary.
